name: Vendor Risk Assessment Framework
description: Comprehensive vendor risk assessment template for DPDP Act 2023 compliance

sections.title: Assessment Overview
sections.description: Evaluate whether a vendor processing personal data meets security and privacy requirements

fields.label: Assessment Name
fields.aiQuestion: What would you like to name this assessment? (e.g., 'Q1 2026 CRM Vendor Review', 'AWS Cloud Platform Assessment', 'Salesforce Data Processor Review')

fields.label: Assessment Date
fields.aiQuestion: What's the assessment date? You can type it in DD/MM/YYYY format or just say 'today' to use today's date.

fields.label: Business Unit Requesting Vendor
fields.aiQuestion: Which business unit is requesting this vendor? (e.g., 'Customer Support', 'Human Resources', 'Finance', 'IT / Engineering', 'Marketing')

fields.label: Vendor Name
fields.aiQuestion: What's the vendor's name? (e.g., 'Salesforce India Pvt Ltd', 'AWS', 'Zoho Corporation')

fields.label: Vendor Service Description
fields.aiQuestion: Could you briefly describe what service this vendor provides? (e.g., 'Cloud-based CRM platform for managing customer interactions', 'Payroll processing and HR management SaaS', 'Email delivery and marketing automation service')

aiInstructions.systemPrompt: You are helping a user complete a Vendor Risk Assessment under India's DPDP Act 2023. Ask questions conversationally, one at a time. Be professional but friendly.

sections.title: Vendor Basic Information
sections.description: Legal and contact details of the vendor

fields.label: Vendor Legal Name
fields.aiQuestion: What is the vendor's legal/registered name as it appears on official documents? (e.g., 'Salesforce India Private Limited', 'Amazon Web Services India Pvt Ltd', 'Zoho Corporation Private Limited')

fields.label: Registered Address
fields.aiQuestion: What's the vendor's registered business address? (e.g., '5th Floor, Prestige Tech Park, Marathahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka - 560037')

fields.label: Country of Operation
fields.aiQuestion: Which country does the vendor primarily operate from? (e.g., 'India', 'United States', 'Singapore')

fields.label: Website
fields.aiQuestion: What's the vendor's website URL? (Optional — e.g., 'https://www.salesforce.com', 'https://aws.amazon.com')

fields.label: Primary Contact Name
fields.aiQuestion: Who is the primary contact person at the vendor for this engagement? (e.g., 'Rajesh Sharma — Account Manager', 'Priya Mehta — Data Protection Officer')

fields.label: Contact Email
fields.aiQuestion: What's the primary contact's email address? (e.g., 'rajesh.sharma@vendorname.com')

fields.label: Contact Phone
fields.aiQuestion: And their phone number, including country code? (e.g., '+91 98765 43210', '+1 415 555 0100')

sections.title: Service Description
sections.description: Purpose and nature of the vendor relationship

fields.label: What service does the vendor provide?
fields.aiQuestion: Please describe in detail what service the vendor provides to your organization and how your team uses it. (e.g., 'We use their CRM platform to log and manage all customer support tickets. Support agents access it daily to resolve complaints and track customer issues. The platform stores customer name, email, phone, and conversation history.')

fields.label: Does the vendor process personal data on behalf of your organization?
fields.aiQuestion: Does the vendor process personal data on behalf of your organization? Answer Yes if the vendor handles, stores, analyzes, or transmits personal data of your customers, employees, or other individuals on your instructions. (Yes / No)

fields.label: Is the service critical to business operations?
fields.aiQuestion: Is this service critical to your business operations? Answer Yes if its unavailability would significantly disrupt your operations or customer commitments. (Yes / No)

sections.title: Personal Data Processing
sections.description: Categories and volume of personal data processed

fields.label: Categories of Personal Data
fields.aiQuestion: Which categories of personal data will the vendor process? Select all that apply — Name, Email, Phone Number, Address, IP Address, Financial Data, Health Data, Biometric Data. (e.g., for a CRM tool: 'Name, Email, Phone Number'; for an HR system: 'Name, Email, Financial Data')

fields.label: Data Subjects
fields.aiQuestion: Whose data will the vendor process? Select all that apply — Customers, Employees, Vendors, Website Users. (e.g., for a CRM: 'Customers, Website Users'; for payroll software: 'Employees')

fields.label: Volume of Data
fields.aiQuestion: What's the expected volume of data records this vendor will process? Choose the closest estimate — Less than 1,000 / 1,000–100,000 / More than 100,000. (e.g., an internal HR tool may handle <1,000 employee records; a customer-facing CRM could handle 10,000+)

sections.title: Purpose of Processing
sections.description: Why the vendor needs the data

fields.label: Purpose of Processing
fields.aiQuestion: Why does the vendor need to process this personal data? Be specific about the business purpose. (e.g., 'To resolve customer support tickets and track issue history', 'To process employee payroll and generate salary slips', 'To send transactional emails and delivery notifications to customers')

fields.label: Processing Activities
fields.aiQuestion: What specific processing activities will the vendor perform on the data? (e.g., 'Storage, querying, and retrieval of customer records'; 'Collection, storage, and sharing with sub-processors for email delivery'; 'Analysis and profiling for fraud detection')

sections.title: Data Storage & Location
sections.description: Important for DPDP compliance regarding cross-border transfers

fields.label: Where is the data stored?
fields.aiQuestion: Where will the personal data be stored — India, Outside India, or Both? (e.g., if the vendor uses AWS Mumbai region only: 'India'; if they use US/EU servers: 'Outside India'; if they have both Indian and overseas data centres: 'Both')

fields.label: List Countries Where Data Is Stored
fields.aiQuestion: Please list all specific countries where data will be stored or processed. (e.g., 'India' / 'India, Singapore' / 'India, United States, Germany' — list each country separated by commas)

fields.label: Is cross-border data transfer involved?
fields.aiQuestion: Is cross-border data transfer involved? Answer Yes if personal data physically moves to servers or personnel outside India as part of normal operations. (Yes / No)

sections.title: Security Safeguards
sections.description: Vendor must demonstrate reasonable security safeguards

fields.label: Encryption at rest
fields.aiQuestion: Does the vendor encrypt stored data at rest (AES-256 or equivalent)? This means data sitting in databases or file systems is unreadable without a key. (Yes / No)

fields.label: Encryption in transit
fields.aiQuestion: Does the vendor use encryption in transit (e.g., TLS 1.2+)? This means data is encrypted as it travels over the network. (Yes / No)

fields.label: Multi-factor authentication
fields.aiQuestion: Is multi-factor authentication (MFA/2FA) required for users accessing the system — especially admin accounts? (Yes / No)

fields.label: Role-based access control
fields.aiQuestion: Is role-based access control (RBAC) in place, so that employees can only access the data they need for their specific role? (Yes / No)

fields.label: Security monitoring
fields.aiQuestion: Does the vendor have active security monitoring — such as intrusion detection, SIEM, or 24x7 security operations? (Yes / No)

fields.label: Backup and disaster recovery
fields.aiQuestion: Are automated data backup and a tested disaster recovery plan in place, ensuring data can be restored after an incident? (Yes / No)

fields.label: Do employees receive security training?
fields.aiQuestion: Do vendor employees who handle your data receive regular security awareness training (at least annually)? (Yes / No)

fields.label: Are background checks conducted?
fields.aiQuestion: Are background checks (criminal record / employment history verification) conducted for vendor employees who will have access to your data? (Yes / No)

fields.label: Is there an incident response plan?
fields.aiQuestion: Does the vendor have a documented incident response plan that covers data breaches and security incidents — with defined roles, timelines, and escalation steps? (Yes / No)

fields.label: Is there a dedicated security team?
fields.aiQuestion: Does the vendor have a dedicated security team or a designated security officer (CISO / DPO) responsible for data protection? (Yes / No)

fields.label: Compliance Certifications
fields.aiQuestion: Which compliance certifications does the vendor currently hold? Select all that apply — ISO 27001 (information security), SOC 2 (security/availability controls), PCI DSS (payment card data), GDPR Compliance (European data protection), or None. (Tip: ask the vendor for their latest certificate if unsure)

sections.title: Sub-Processors
sections.description: Does the vendor rely on other processors?

fields.label: Uses Subprocessors?
fields.aiQuestion: Does the vendor use any sub-processors — third-party services that they share your data with in order to deliver the service? (e.g., cloud infrastructure providers like AWS/Azure, email gateways like SendGrid, analytics tools). (Yes / No)

fields.label: Subprocessor Details
fields.placeholder: e.g., AWS | India | Cloud hosting\nSendGrid | USA | Email delivery
fields.aiQuestion:
Please list each sub-processor on a new line in this format: Name | Country | Service.

Example:
Amazon Web Services | India | Cloud infrastructure and data storage
SendGrid | United States | Transactional email delivery
Google Analytics | United States | Usage analytics

sections.title: Data Retention
sections.description: How long will data be retained?

fields.label: How long will the vendor retain personal data?
fields.aiQuestion: How long will the vendor retain personal data after it is collected or after the contract ends? Choose the closest option — less than 30 days, 30–90 days, 90–365 days, 1–3 years, or more than 3 years. (Tip: check the vendor's data retention policy or DPA)

fields.label: Does vendor delete data after contract termination?
fields.aiQuestion: Has the vendor committed to securely deleting or returning all your data after the contract ends? This is a key DPDP Act requirement for data processors. (Yes / No)

fields.label: Does vendor have breach detection mechanisms?
fields.aiQuestion: Does the vendor have technical mechanisms in place to detect a data breach — such as anomaly detection, access log monitoring, or intrusion detection systems? (Yes / No)

fields.label: Breach notification timeline
fields.aiQuestion: Within what timeframe has the vendor contractually committed to notifying you of a data breach? (Note: DPDP Act requires notification to the Data Protection Board within 72 hours — choose the vendor's committed timeline)

sections.title: Data Principal Rights Support
sections.description: Vendor must support rights under DPDP

fields.label: Data access requests supported
fields.aiQuestion: Can the vendor technically support data access requests — i.e., provide a copy of all personal data held about a specific individual when requested under DPDP Act? (Yes / No)

fields.label: Data correction supported
fields.aiQuestion: Can the vendor correct or update inaccurate personal data upon request — a right guaranteed to individuals under DPDP Act? (Yes / No)

fields.label: Data deletion supported
fields.aiQuestion: Can the vendor permanently delete a specific individual's personal data upon a valid erasure request under DPDP Act — including from backups within a reasonable timeframe? (Yes / No)

fields.label: Consent withdrawal supported
fields.aiQuestion: Can the vendor stop processing personal data and remove it if an individual withdraws their consent — a core right under DPDP Act? (Yes / No)

sections.title: Risk Assessment Outcome
Approval

fields.label: Privacy Team Review
fields.aiQuestion: Who from the Privacy/Legal Team reviewed this assessment? (Optional — e.g., 'Anita Kapoor, DPO' or 'Legal & Compliance Team')

fields.label: Security Team Review
fields.aiQuestion: Who from the Information Security Team reviewed this assessment? (Optional — e.g., 'Vikram Nair, CISO' or 'IT Security Team')

fields.label: Approval Status
fields.aiQuestion: What is the final approval decision for this vendor? Options: 'Approved' (vendor meets all requirements), 'Approved with conditions' (vendor can proceed but must address specific gaps), or 'Rejected' (vendor does not meet minimum requirements).

fields.label: Conditions for Approval
fields.aiQuestion: Please list the conditions that must be met before or during the engagement. (e.g., 'Vendor must provide ISO 27001 certificate within 30 days', 'DPA must be signed before go-live', 'Cross-border transfer must be restricted to India-only servers by Q3 2026')

fields.label: Next Review Date
fields.aiQuestion: When should the next periodic review of this vendor be conducted? (e.g., '31/12/2026' for annual review, or '30/06/2026' for 6-month review — HIGH risk vendors are typically reviewed every 6 months)
